macros.name: DeclareTblrTemplate
macros.doc: For elements in Table 4.4, you can use \DeclareTblrTemplate to define and modify templates, and use \SetTblrTemplate to choose default templates.

macros.name: InsertTblrText
macros.doc: The command \InsertTblrText{caption} inserts the value of caption key, which you could write in the optional argument of longtblr environment.

macros.name: MapTblrNotes
macros.doc: The \MapTblrNotes command loops for all table notes, which are written in the optional argument of longtblr environment.

macros.name: NewTblrTheme
macros.doc: You may define your own themes for table heads and foots with \NewTblrTheme command. a theme consists of some template and style settings.

macros.name: SetCell
macros.doc: you can set spanned cells with \SetCell command: within the optional argument of \SetCell command, option r is for rowspan number, and c for colspan number; within the mandatory argument of it, horizontal and vertical alignment options are accepted.

macros.name: SetCell

macros.name: SetCells
macros.doc: table command \SetCells[<span>]{<styles>} at the beginning of some cell is the same as table option cells={<span>}{<styles>}.

macros.name: SetHline
macros.doc: table command \SetHline[<index>]{<columns>}{<styles>} at the beginning of row i is the same as table option hline{i}={<index>}{<columns>}{<styles>}.

macros.name: SetHline
macros.doc: table command \SetHline[<index>]{<columns>}{<styles>} at the beginning of row i is the same as table option hline{i}={<index>}{<columns>}{<styles>}.

macros.name: SetHlines

macros.name: SetRow
macros.doc: table command \SetRow{<styles>} at the beginning of row i is the same as table option row{i}={<styles>}.

macros.name: SetTblrOuter
macros.doc: Tabularray package provides \SetTblrInner and \SetTblrOuter commands for you to change the default inner and outer specifications of tables.

macros.name: SetTblrOuter
macros.doc: Tabularray package provides \SetTblrInner and \SetTblrOuter commands for you to change the default inner and outer specifications of tables.

macros.name: SetTblrTracing
macros.doc: To trace internal data behind tblr environment, you can use \SetTblrTracing command.

macros.name: UseTblrLibrary
macros.doc: A tabularray library could be loaded by \UseTblrLibrary command.

macros.name: UseTblrTemplate
macros.doc: When you write \UseTblrTemplate{element}{default} in defining a template, beside including template code of the element, the foreground color and font commands of the element will be set up automatically.

macros.name: vborder
macros.doc: table command \hborder{<specs>} at the beginning of row i is the same as table option hborder{i}={<specs>}, and table command \vborder{<specs>} at the beginning of column j is the same as table option vborder{j}={<specs>}.

envs.name: +array
envs.doc: With \UseTblrLibrary{amsmath} in the preamble of the document, tabularray will load amsmath package, and define +array, +matrix, +bmatrix, +Bmatrix, +pmatrix, +vmatrix, +Vmatrix and +cases environments. Each of the environments is similar to the environment without + prefix in its name, but has default rowsep=2pt just as tblr environment.
